dafc8dd3ab.q: What advice does Marina Petrovich give to people considering leaving corporate to start a career coaching business?

She also recommends getting your first three clients before quitting, as one client is luck, two is a trend, three is a process.

a87d458da2.q: Why is career coaching adoption still so low compared to real estate agents and financial advisors?
a87d458da2.a: Career coaching adoption is only 2 to 10 percent while real estate agents are used by 90+ percent and financial advisors by 20 to 40 percent, despite career choices being equally impactful on retirement and housing decisions. The barrier is the payment model: real estate agents and financial advisors are paid on the backend (commission or assets under management), so clients do not write a check upfront. Until career coaches can normalize backend payment models similar to financial advisors, the industry will struggle to grow adoption.

75aed7ea7d.q: What is the key difference between transactional recruiting at Meta or Google versus relationship-based career coaching?
75aed7ea7d.a: In recruiting roles at Meta and Google, the relationship feels transactional because you deal with high volume, your incentive is to represent the company, and if a candidate does not make it you move on to the next with a generic email. In career coaching, the client is the job seeker and your incentive is to make sure they are happy and get the job, so the company becomes the transaction—if it does not work out with one employer, you move to the next together.
